name: logo-generator
description: Generate and refine logos from a brand name, style, color theme, and design brief using built-in image generation.

interface.longDescription: Create logo concepts from your brand name, business, style, colors, typography, symbols, and intended use. Refine existing logos, request transparent images or simple editable SVGs, and use ready-made example prompts. Uses the host’s built-in image generation when available; includes no external image service.
defaultPrompt: Create a logo for my business. Ask for my brand name, preferred style, and color theme if I have not supplied them.
Create a minimal logo for Leaf & Bean, a neighborhood café, in forest green and cream. No tagline.
Help me refine an existing logo while preserving its exact brand name and key design elements.
